+

+  clip-path: polygon(50% 0, 62% 38%, 100% 50%, 62% 62%, 50% 100%, 38% 62%, 0 50%, 38% 38%);

+  to {

+.SkyblockReachLogButton {
+  align-items: center;
+  background: radial-gradient(circle at 50% 40%, rgba(195, 125, 255, .35), rgba(26, 31, 46, .92) 70%);
+  border: 1px solid rgba(195, 125, 255, .7);
+  border-radius: 0;
+  box-sizing: border-box;
+  cursor: pointer;
+  display: flex;
+  flex: none;
+  height: 2.5rem;
+  justify-content: center;
+  order: -1;
+  padding: 0;
+  pointer-events: auto;
+  position: relative;
+  width: 4.5rem
+}
+
+.SkyblockReachLogButton:before {
+  content: "";
+  inset: -2.5rem -.25rem 0;
+  position: absolute
+}
+
+.SkyblockReachLogButton:after {
+  border-radius: inherit;
+  box-shadow: 0 0 .9rem rgba(60, 225, 195, .9);
+  content: "";
+  inset: -2px;
+  opacity: 0;
+  pointer-events: none;
+  position: absolute
+}
+
+@media(hover:hover) {
+  .SkyblockReachLogButton:hover {
+    border-color: #3ce1c3
+  }
+}
+
+.SkyblockReachLogButton.pad-focused {
+  border-color: #3ce1c3
+}
+
+@media(hover:none) {
+  .SkyblockReachLogButton:active {
+    border-color: #3ce1c3
+  }
+}
+
+.SkyblockReachLogButton.HasNews:after {
+  animation: SkyblockReachLogNews 1.6s ease-in-out 6 alternate;
+  opacity: .6
+}
+
+.SkyblockReachLogButton .SkyblockReachLogIcon {
+  display: block;
+  height: 2.2rem;
+  width: 2.2rem
+}
+
+.SkyblockReachLogButton .SkyblockReachLogIcon.Jump {
+  animation: SkyblockReachLogIconJump .7s ease-out
+}
+
+.SkyblockReachLogButton .SkyblockReachLogPulse {
+  animation: SkyblockReachLogPulse .9s ease-out;
+  border: 2px solid #3ce1c3;
+  border-radius: inherit;
+  box-shadow: 0 0 .6rem #3ce1c3;
+  inset: -2px;
+  opacity: 0;
+  pointer-events: none;
+  position: absolute
+}
+
+.SkyblockReachLogButton.Pending {
+  opacity: .6
+}
+
+.SkyblockReachLogButton .SkyblockReachLogBadge {
+  background: #3ce1c3;
+  box-shadow: 0 0 .4rem #3ce1c3;
+  box-sizing: border-box;
+  color: #1a1f2e;
+  font-size: .95rem;
+  height: 1.2rem;
+  line-height: 1.2rem;
+  min-width: 1.2rem;
+  padding: 0 .25rem;
+  position: absolute;
+  right: -.35rem;
+  text-align: center;
+  top: -.6rem;
+  z-index: 1
+}
+
+@keyframes SkyblockReachLogNews {
+  0% {
+    opacity: .6
+  }
+
+  to {
+    opacity: 1
+  }
+}
+
+@keyframes SkyblockReachLogPulse {
+  0% {
+    opacity: 1;
+    transform: scale(1)
+  }
+
+  to {
+    opacity: 0;
+    transform: scale(1.35, 1.7)
+  }
+}
+
+@keyframes SkyblockReachLogPulseFade {
+  0% {
+    opacity: 1
+  }
+
+  to {
+    opacity: 0
+  }
+}
+
+@keyframes SkyblockReachLogIconJump {
+  0% {
+    transform: none
+  }
+
+  30% {
+    transform: translateY(-.5rem) scale(1.3) rotate(-14deg)
+  }
+
+  55% {
+    transform: translateY(0) scale(1.1) rotate(8deg)
+  }
+
+  75% {
+    transform: rotate(-4deg)
+  }
+
+  to {
+    transform: none
+  }
+}
+
+@media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce) {
+
+  .SkyblockReachLogButton .SkyblockReachLogIcon.Jump,
+  .SkyblockReachLogButton.HasNews:after {
+    animation: none
+  }
+
+  .SkyblockReachLogButton .SkyblockReachLogPulse {
+    animation-name: SkyblockReachLogPulseFade
+  }
+}

+  background: radial-gradient(ellipse 90% 40% at 50% 105%, rgba(60, 225, 195, .16), transparent), radial-gradient(ellipse 60% 35% at 15% 0, rgba(195, 125, 255, .14), transparent);
+  contain: strict;
+  inset: 0;
+  pointer-events: none;
+  position: absolute;
+  z-index: -1
+}
+
+.SkyblockReachLogPanel .SkyblockReachLogDepths.Island-harbour {

+

+}

+.SkyblockReachLogPanel .SkyblockReachLogShaft {
+  animation: SkyblockReachLogShaft var(--duration) ease-in-out var(--delay) infinite alternate;
+  background: radial-gradient(ellipse 50% 100% at 50% 0, rgba(60, 225, 195, .16), transparent);
+  height: 120%;
+  left: var(--left);
+  opacity: .6;
+  position: absolute;
+  top: -10%;
+  transform: rotate(var(--tilt));
+  transform-origin: 50% 0;
+  width: 8rem
+}
+
+.SkyblockReachLogPanel .SkyblockReachLogMote {
+  animation: SkyblockReachLogMote var(--duration) ease-in-out var(--delay) infinite alternate;
+  background: radial-gradient(circle, var(--island-glow), transparent 70%);
+  height: var(--size);
+  left: var(--x);
+  opacity: .12;
+  position: absolute;
+  top: var(--y);
+  width: var(--size)
+}
+
+.SkyblockReachLogPanel .SkyblockReachLogMote.Violet {
+  background: radial-gradient(circle, #c37dff, transparent 70%)
+}
+
+.SkyblockReachLogPanel .SkyblockReachLogBubble {
+  animation: SkyblockReachLogBubbleRise var(--duration) linear var(--delay) infinite, SkyblockReachLogBubbleSway calc(var(--duration)/4) ease-in-out var(--delay) infinite alternate;
+  height: 100%;
+  left: var(--left);
+  opacity: 0;
+  position: absolute;
+  top: 100%;
+  width: var(--size)
+}
+
+.SkyblockReachLogPanel .SkyblockReachLogBubble:before {
+  background: radial-gradient(circle at 35% 30%, rgba(205, 222, 240, .8) 0 20%, rgba(60, 225, 195, .2) 45%, transparent 70%);
+  border: 1px solid rgba(60, 225, 195, .75);
+  border-radius: 50%;
+  box-sizing: border-box;
+  content: "";
+  height: var(--size);
+  left: 0;
+  position: absolute;
+  top: 0;
+  width: var(--size)
+}
+
+@keyframes SkyblockReachLogShaft {
+  0% {
+    opacity: .35;
+    transform: rotate(calc(var(--tilt) - 4deg))
+  }
+
+  to {
+    opacity: 1;
+    transform: rotate(calc(var(--tilt) + 4deg))
+  }
+}
+
+@keyframes SkyblockReachLogMote {
+  0% {
+    opacity: .08;
+    transform: translateZ(0) scale(.85)
+  }
+
+  to {
+    opacity: .3;
+    transform: translate3d(var(--drift-x), var(--drift-y), 0) scale(1.1)
+  }
+}
+
+@keyframes SkyblockReachLogBubbleRise {
+  0% {
+    opacity: 0;
+    transform: translateZ(0)
+  }
+
+  10% {
+    opacity: 1
+  }
+
+  80% {
+    opacity: .8
+  }
+
+  to {
+    opacity: 0;
+    transform: translate3d(0, -100%, 0)
+  }
+}
+
+@keyframes SkyblockReachLogBubbleSway {
+  0% {
+    translate: calc(var(--sway)*-1) 0
+  }
+
+  to {
+    translate: var(--sway) 0
+  }
+}
+
+@media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce) {
+
+  .SkyblockReachLogPanel .SkyblockReachLogMote,
+  .SkyblockReachLogPanel .SkyblockReachLogShaft {
+    animation: none
+  }
+
+  .SkyblockReachLogPanel .SkyblockReachLogBubble {
+    display: none
+  }
+}
+

+}

+  box-shadow: 0 0 1.5rem rgba(195, 125, 255, .35), .2rem .25rem 0 rgba(0, 0, 0, .32);
+  max-height: 92dvh;
+  width: min(46rem, 94vw)
+}
+
+.SkyblockTideChartsPanel .SkyblockTideChartsHeader {
+  align-items: flex-start;
+  display: flex;
+  gap: 1rem;
+  padding: .9rem 1.2rem .3rem
+}
+
+.SkyblockTideChartsPanel .SkyblockTideChartsHeader>div {
+  flex: 1 1;
+  min-width: 0
+}
+
+.SkyblockTideChartsPanel .SkyblockTideChartsHeader h2 {
+  color: #c37dff;
+  font-size: 1.7rem;
+  margin: 0;
+  text-shadow: 0 0 .6rem rgba(195, 125, 255, .7)
+}
+
+.SkyblockTideChartsPanel .SkyblockTideChartsHeader .ExitButton {
+  flex: none
+}
+
+.SkyblockTideChartsPanel .SkyblockTideChartsIntro {
+  color: #cfcfcf;
+  font-size: 1.05rem;
+  font-style: italic;
+  margin: .1rem 0 0
+}
+
+.SkyblockTideChartsPanel .SkyblockTideChartsTabs {
+  display: flex;
+  flex-wrap: wrap;
+  gap: .4rem;
+  padding: .2rem 1.2rem .4rem
+}
+
+.SkyblockTideChartsPanel .SkyblockTideChartsTab {
+  background: rgba(34, 40, 59, .85);
+  border: 2px solid rgba(195, 125, 255, .4);
+  border-radius: 0;
+  color: #ece8ff;
+  cursor: pointer;
+  font-size: 1rem;
+  min-height: 32px;
+  padding: .25rem .7rem
+}
+
+@media(hover:hover) {
+  .SkyblockTideChartsPanel .SkyblockTideChartsTab:hover {
+    border-color: #c37dff
+  }
+}
+
+.SkyblockTideChartsPanel .SkyblockTideChartsTab.pad-focused {
+  border-color: #c37dff
+}
+
+@media(hover:none) {
+  .SkyblockTideChartsPanel .SkyblockTideChartsTab:active {
+    border-color: #c37dff
+  }
+}
+
+.SkyblockTideChartsPanel .SkyblockTideChartsTab.Selected {
+  border-color: #3ce1c3;
+  box-shadow: 0 0 .5rem rgba(60, 225, 195, .6)
+}
+
+.SkyblockTideChartsPanel .SkyblockTideChartsTab:focus-visible {
+  outline: 2px solid #ece8ff
+}
+
+.SkyblockTideChartsPanel .SkyblockTideChartsBody {
+  grid-gap: 1.2rem;
+  display: grid;
+  gap: 1.2rem;
+  grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 17rem) minmax(0, 1fr);
+  min-height: 0;
+  overflow-y: auto;
+  padding: .4rem 1.2rem 1rem
+}
+
+.SkyblockTideChartsPanel .SkyblockTideChartsMap {
+  width: min(17rem, 52dvh)
+}
+
+.SkyblockTideChartsPanel .SkyblockTideChartsInfo {
+  display: flex;
+  flex-direction: column;
+  gap: .45rem;
+  min-width: 0
+}
+
+.SkyblockTideChartsPanel .SkyblockTideChartsInfo h3 {
+  color: #ece8ff;
+  font-size: 1.5rem;
+  margin: 0
+}
+
+.SkyblockTideChartsPanel .SkyblockTideChartsInfo p {
+  margin: 0
+}
+
+.SkyblockTideChartsPanel .SkyblockTideChartsLit {
+  color: #3ce1c3;
+  font-size: 1.3rem;
+  text-shadow: 0 0 .4rem rgba(60, 225, 195, .6)
+}
+
+.SkyblockTideChartsPanel .SkyblockTideChartsPicture {
+  color: #cfcfcf;
+  font-size: 1.15rem
+}
+
+.SkyblockTideChartsPanel .SkyblockTideChartsPicture.Revealed {
+  animation: SkyblockTideChartReveal 1.2s ease-out both;
+  color: #ece8ff;
+  font-size: 1.4rem;
+  font-weight: 700;
+  text-shadow: 0 0 .5rem #3ce1c3, 0 0 1rem #c37dff
+}
+
+.SkyblockTideChartsPanel .SkyblockTideChartsLegend {
+  color: #cfcfcf;
+  display: flex;
+  flex-wrap: wrap;
+  font-size: 1rem;
+  gap: .3rem .9rem;
+  list-style: none;
+  margin: 0;
+  padding: 0
+}
+
+.SkyblockTideChartsPanel .SkyblockTideChartsLegend li {
+  align-items: center;
+  display: flex;
+  gap: .35rem
+}
+
+.SkyblockTideChartsPanel .SkyblockTideChartsLegend .SkyblockTideChartCell {
+  height: 1rem;
+  width: 1rem
+}
+
+.SkyblockTideChartsPanel .SkyblockTideChartsFooter {
+  border-top: 1px solid rgba(195, 125, 255, .3);
+  color: #ece8ff;
+  display: flex;
+  flex-direction: column;
+  font-size: 1.05rem;
+  gap: .15rem;
+  margin-top: auto;
+  padding-top: .5rem
+}
+
+@keyframes SkyblockTideChartReveal {
+  0% {
+    opacity: 0;
+    transform: scale(.85)
+  }
+
+  to {
+    opacity: 1;
+    transform: none
+  }
+}
+
+@media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce) {
+  .SkyblockTideChartsPicture.Revealed {
+    animation-duration: 1ms !important
+  }
+}
+
+@media(max-width:480px) {
+  .SkyblockTideChartsPanel .SkyblockTideChartsBody {
+    grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr)
+  }
+}
+
+@media(max-height:650px), (max-width:1000px) {
+  .SkyblockTideChartsChip {
+    height: 3.5rem;
+    justify-content: center;
+    margin: -1rem -.25rem 0;
+    padding: .15rem;
+    width: 3rem
+  }
+
+  .SkyblockTideChartsChip:before {
+    inset: -1.5rem -.375rem 0
+  }
+
+  .SkyblockTideChartsChip:after {
+    content: "";
+    inset: -1.5rem -.625rem 100%;
+    position: absolute
+  }
+
+  .SkyblockTideChartsChip .SkyblockTideChartGrid.Mini {
+    height: auto;
+    width: 100%
+  }
+
+  .SkyblockTideChartsChipCount {
+    display: none
+  }
+}

+.Baf2ColliderPanel {
+  overflow: hidden;
+  width: min(54rem, 96vw)
+}
+
+.Baf2ColliderPanel .Baf2PanelHeader {
+  flex-shrink: 0
+}
+
+.Baf2ColliderPanel .Baf2ColTitle {
+  align-items: center;
+  display: flex;
+  gap: .8rem;
+  min-width: 0
+}
+
+.Baf2ColliderPanel .Baf2ColBody {
+  grid-gap: 1.2rem;
+  display: grid;
+  flex: 1 1 auto;
+  gap: 1.2rem;
+  grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1.2fr) minmax(0, 1fr);
+  min-height: 0;
+  overflow-y: auto;
+  padding: 1rem 1.5rem 1.5rem;
+  scrollbar-color: hsla(0, 0%, 100%, .45) transparent;
+  scrollbar-width: thin

+  display: flex;
+  flex-direction: column;
+  gap: .7rem;

+  color: #cfcfcf;

+}

+  flex-direction: column;
+  gap: .35rem
+}

+  line-height: 1.1

+  background-size: 14.2857142857% 14.2857142857%;

+.Baf2ColliderPanel .Baf2ColDiagramClosed,
+.Baf2ColliderPanel .Baf2ColDiagramFocus,

+.Baf2ColliderPanel .Baf2ColDiagramLaser {

+.NxPipe {
+  align-self: center;
+  background-image: repeating-linear-gradient(90deg, currentColor 0 6px, transparent 6px 10px);
+  background-size: 10px 3px;
+  color: #838383;
+  display: block;
+  height: 3px;
+  margin-right: 5px;
+  position: relative
+}
+
+.NxPipe.Fuel {
+  color: #b6ff3b
+}
+
+.NxPipe.Water {
+  color: #3fd0f0
+}
+

+  color: #a8f0ff
+}
+
+.NxPipe.Power {
+  color: #f2c94c
+}
+
+.NxPipe.Waste {
+  color: #d9a73a
+}
+
+.NxPipe.Store {
+  color: #f2c94c
+}
+
+.NxPipe:after {
+  border: 4.5px solid transparent;
+  border-left: 5px solid;
+  border-right: 0;
+  content: "";
+  position: absolute;
+  right: -5px;
+  top: -3px
+}
+
+.NxPipe.Planned,
+.NxPipe.Step0 {
+  color: #838383
+}
+
+.NxPipe.Short {
+  color: #ffb914
+}
+
+.NxPipe.Short:before {
+  color: #fcd373;
+  content: "!";
+  font-size: 10px;
+  font-weight: 700;
+  left: 50%;
+  position: absolute;
+  top: -1.1em;
+  transform: translateX(-50%)
+}
+
+.NxPipe.Step1 {
+  animation: NxPipeFlow 1.6s linear infinite
+}
+
+.NxPipe.Step2 {
+  animation: NxPipeFlow .8s linear infinite
+}
+
+.NxPipe.Step3 {
+  animation: NxPipeFlow .45s linear infinite
+}
+
+.NxPipe.Step4 {
+  animation: NxPipeFlow .25s linear infinite
+}
+
+.NxPipe.Planned {
+  animation: none
+}
+
+@keyframes NxPipeFlow {
+  0% {
+    background-position: 0 0
+  }
+
+  to {
+    background-position: 10px 0
+  }
+}

+.NxGauge {

+.NxGaugeBand.warm {

+}

+.NxGaugeBand.Empty {

+}

+.NxGaugeNow,
+.NxGaugeSettle {
+  height: 4px;
+  left: -3px;
+  margin-bottom: -2px;
+  position: absolute;
+  right: -3px;

+.NxGaugeNow {

+.NxStatus {

+.rangeslider-vertical .rangeslider__handle-tooltip {

+@keyframes HelperSlideKeyFrame {
+  0% {
+    transform: translateY(calc(-100% - 30px))
+  }
+
+  33% {
+    transform: translateY(0)
+  }
+
+  to {
+    transform: translateY(0)
+  }
+}
+
+@keyframes HelperSlideKeyFrameReverse {
+  0% {
+    transform: translateY(0)
+  }
+
+  66% {
+    transform: translateY(0)
+  }
+
+  to {
+    transform: translateY(calc(-100% - 30px))
+  }
+}
+
+@keyframes ExpandNotification {
+  0% {
+    transform: scaleX(.05)
+  }
+
+  33% {
+    transform: scaleX(.05)
+  }
+
+  66% {
+    transform: scaleX(1)
+  }
+}
+
+@keyframes CloseNotification {
+  0% {
+    transform: scaleX(1)
+  }
+
+  33% {
+    transform: scaleX(1)
+  }
+
+  66% {
+    transform: scaleX(1)
+  }
+}
+
+@keyframes textAppear {
+  0% {
+    opacity: 0
+  }
+
+  66% {
+    opacity: 0
+  }
+
+  to {
+    opacity: 1
+  }
+}
+
+@keyframes textDisappear {
+  0% {

+.ResizableSidePanel {
+  --handleWidth: 0.7rem;
+  --panelCloseSize: 1rem;
+  --panelCloseWidth: calc(var(--panelCloseSize)*2.2);
+  --panelCloseGap: 0.9rem;
+  --panelHeaderHeight: 3rem;
+  box-sizing: border-box;
+  display: flex;
+  flex-shrink: 1;
+  min-height: 0;
+  min-width: 8rem;
+  position: relative
+}
+
+@media(pointer:coarse) {
+  .ResizableSidePanel {
+    --handleWidth: 1.2rem
+  }
+}
+
+@media(max-height:520px) {
+  .ResizableSidePanel {
+    --panelCloseSize: 14px;
+    --panelCloseGap: 12px;
+    --panelHeaderHeight: 36px
+  }
+}
+
+.ResizableSidePanel>:first-child {
+  flex: 1 1;
+  min-width: 0
+}
+
+.ResizableSidePanel.ResizableSidePanel-left {
+  border-right: 2px solid #22283b
+}

+.ResizableSidePanel.ResizableSidePanel-left .ResizableSidePanelHandle {
+  right: -2px
+}
+
+.ResizableSidePanel.ResizableSidePanel-left .ResizableSidePanelHandle:after {
+  left: auto;
+  right: 0;
+  transform: none
+}
+
+.ResizableSidePanel.ResizableSidePanel-right {
+  border-left: 2px solid #22283b
+}
+
+.ResizableSidePanel.ResizableSidePanel-right .ResizableSidePanelHandle {
+  left: -2px
+}
+
+.ResizableSidePanel.ResizableSidePanel-right .ResizableSidePanelHandle:after {
+  left: 0;
+  transform: none
+}
+
+.ResizableSidePanel.ResizableSidePanel-top {
+  border-bottom: 2px solid #22283b;
+  min-width: 0
+}
+
+.ResizableSidePanel.ResizableSidePanel-top .ResizableSidePanelHandle {
+  bottom: -2px;
+  cursor: row-resize;
+  height: var(--handleWidth);
+  left: 0;
+  right: 0;
+  top: auto;
+  width: auto
+}
+
+.ResizableSidePanel.ResizableSidePanel-top .ResizableSidePanelHandle:after {
+  bottom: 0;
+  height: 2px;
+  left: 0;
+  right: 0;
+  top: auto;
+  transform: none;
+  width: auto
+}
+
+.ResizableSidePanel.ResizableSidePanel-top .ResizableSidePanelHandle:before {
+  background-color: #a6adc8;
+  bottom: 1px;
+  content: "";

+  stroke-width: 2px;
+  stroke-linejoin: round;
+  paint-order: stroke fill
+}
+
+.ReplayFreecamTouchControls .ReplayFreecamVerticalButton:active {
+  background-color: rgba(34, 40, 59, .85)
+}
+
+.ReplayFreecamTouchControls .ReplayFreecamVerticalIcon {
+  color: #fff;
+  font-size: calc(var(--touch-unit)*2);
+  pointer-events: none
+}
+
+.RecordingIndicator {
+  align-items: center;
+  background: #e34f4f;
+  color: #f2f2f2;
+  display: flex;
+  font-size: 1.5rem;
+  font-weight: 700;
+  gap: .4rem;
+  margin-right: -1rem;
+  margin-top: 1rem;
+  padding: .25rem .6rem
+}
+
+.RecordingIndicator .RecordingIndicatorDot {
+  animation: RecordingIndicatorPulse 1.5s ease-in-out infinite;
+  background: #fff;
+  height: .6rem;
+  width: .6rem
+}
+
+.RecordingIndicator .RecordingIndicatorLabel {
+  color: #fff;
+  letter-spacing: .05em
+}
+
+@keyframes RecordingIndicatorPulse {
+
+  0%,
+  to {
+    opacity: 1
+  }
+
+  50% {
+    opacity: .3
+  }
+}
+
+@keyframes rainbowShimmer {
+  0% {
+    transform: translateX(0)
+  }
+
+  to {
+    transform: translateX(88.88889%)
+  }
+}
+
+@keyframes rainbowShimmerPosition {
+  to {
+    background-position: -200% 0
+  }
+}
+
+@keyframes fadeIn {
+  0% {
+    opacity: 0
+  }
+
+  to {
+    opacity: 1
+  }
+}
+
+@keyframes fadeInScaleUp {
+  0% {
+    opacity: 0;
+    transform: scale(.6)
+  }
+
+  50% {
+    opacity: 1;
+    transform: scale(1.1)
+  }
+
+  to {
+    opacity: 1;
+    transform: scale(1)
+  }
+}
+
+@keyframes fadeInScaleUpNoOversize {
+  0% {
+    opacity: 0;
+    transform: scale(.8)
+  }
+
+  to {
+    opacity: 1;
+    transform: scale(1)
+  }
+}
+
+@keyframes shake {
+  0% {
+    rotate: 3deg
+  }
+
+  5% {
+    rotate: -2deg
+  }
+
+  10% {
+    rotate: 2deg
+  }
+
+  15% {
+    rotate: -3deg
+  }
+
+  20% {
+    rotate: 0deg
+  }
+}
+
+@keyframes loadingShimmer {
+  0% {
+    transform: translateX(-66.6666666667%)
+  }
+
+  to {
+    transform: none
+  }
+}
+
+@keyframes topRightStackIn {
+  0% {
+    opacity: 0;
+    transform: translateX(1.5rem)
+  }
+
+  to {
+    opacity: 1;
+    transform: translateX(0)
+  }
+}
+
+.LobbyLeaderboardContainer {
+  box-sizing: border-box;
+  flex: 1 0 1rem;
+  overflow-x: hidden;
+  overflow-y: auto;
+  padding-top: 1.5rem;
+  width: 100%
+}
+
+.LobbyLeaderboardContainer .LobbyLeaderboard {
+  display: flex;
+  font-size: 1.25rem;
+  width: 100%
+}
+
+.LobbyLeaderboardContainer .LobbyLeaderboard table thead th {
+  font-size: 1.25rem;
+  padding: .2em 1em
+}
+
+.LobbyLeaderboardContainer .LobbyLeaderboard table tbody tr {
+  cursor: pointer;
+  position: relative
+}
+
+@media(hover:hover) {
+  .LobbyLeaderboardContainer .LobbyLeaderboard table tbody tr:hover {
+    background-color: #b6830e
+  }
+}
+
+.LobbyLeaderboardContainer .LobbyLeaderboard table tbody tr.pad-focused {
+  background-color: #b6830e
+}
+
+@media(hover:none) {
+  .LobbyLeaderboardContainer .LobbyLeaderboard table tbody tr:active {
+    background-color: #b6830e
+  }
+}
+
+.LobbyLeaderboardContainer .LobbyLeaderboard table tbody tr:nth-of-type(2n) td .LobbyLeaderboardValueBg {
+  background-color: rgba(57, 73, 128, .54)
+}
+
+.LobbyLeaderboardContainer .LobbyLeaderboard table tbody tr:nth-of-type(2n) td:nth-of-type(2n) .LobbyLeaderboardValueBg {
+  background-color: rgba(57, 73, 128, .48)
+}
+
+.LobbyLeaderboardContainer .LobbyLeaderboard table tbody tr td {
+  font-size: 1.4rem;
+  padding: .2em 1em;
+  position: relative
+}
+
+.LobbyLeaderboardContainer .LobbyLeaderboard table tbody tr td .PlayerPfpAndName {
+  align-items: center;
+  display: flex;
+  gap: .5em;
+  justify-content: center
+}
+
+.LobbyLeaderboardContainer .LobbyLeaderboard table tbody tr td:nth-of-type(2n) .LobbyLeaderboardValueBg {
+  background-color: rgba(57, 73, 128, .64)
+}
+
+.LobbyLeaderboardContainer .LobbyLeaderboard table tbody tr td.LobbyLeaderboardValueHighlighted .LobbyLeaderboardValueText {
+  color: #fcd373
+}
+
+.LobbyLeaderboardContainer .LobbyLeaderboard table tbody tr td .LobbyLeaderboardValueText {
+  position: relative;
+  text-align: center;
+  z-index: 2
+}
+
+.LobbyLeaderboardContainer .LobbyLeaderboard table tbody tr td .LobbyLeaderboardValueBg {
+  background-color: rgba(57, 73, 128, .72);
+  height: 100%;
+  left: 0;
+  position: absolute;
+  top: 0;
+  width: 100%;
+  z-index: 1
+}
+
+.Table {
+  border-collapse: collapse;

+}

+@keyframes BoardMugshotGlitch {
+  0% {
+    filter: none;
+    transform: none
+  }
+
+  88% {
+    filter: contrast(1.8);
+    transform: translateX(.05em)
+  }
+
+  90% {
+    filter: brightness(1.4);
+    transform: translateX(-.08em) skewX(6deg)
+  }
+
+  92% {
+    filter: none;
+    transform: none
+  }
+
+  96% {
+    filter: invert(1);
+    transform: translateY(.04em)
+  }
+
+  97% {
+    filter: none;
+    transform: none
+  }
+}

+.StoreCharacterCard {
